The '''Homana system''' was a part of the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Homana [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was home to<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Homanan]]|system=Noola [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Homanan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was introduced in "[[The New Rogues Gallery: Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article written by [[Joe Littrell]] and published in the [[May]] [[1991]] [[Polyhedron 59|fifty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion">{{PolyhedronCite|59|The New Rogues Gallery: Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
